title: Numa Studio STATE/people.json (schema_version 1)
description: PRIVATE people and consent data: staff, instructors, providers, partners and members. Lives only in STATE/people.json (synced to Drive _Plan/people.json); never committed to the public plugin repo, which names only roles plus the co-founders. The crew reads it at run time to decide who may appear, whose words may be used, who to tag as a collaborator and whose stories to lead with. Example with placeholder names: docs/examples/people.example.json. See docs/CONTRACTS.md section 6 (brand.json consent.people_file).

source.description: Where the data came from, e.g. the owners' setup answers and their date.

location.description: Drive link or path of the consent log; null while unknown.

kids.description: The children rule in force, e.g. "never until the owners decide".

kind.description: founder (co-founders), staff (studio staff), instructor (yoga teacher, breathwork guide), provider (collective providers: counseling, massage, facials), partner (not employed: partner physician, partner athletes), social (posts to social media), member, child (under 18; kids never appear until the owners decide), adviser, other.

on_camera.description: true: may appear (with the consent below); false: never; null: ask first (treat as no during a run).

do_not_feature.description: true: never feature this person, even if they are in a shot by chance (crop, swap or skip).

collab.description: Does collab posts with Numa (invite as collaborator).

lead_member_stories.description: A member story to lead with (the owners named them).

active_until.description: Last day on the team, if known; don't plan shoots after it.

status.description: yes on record, a recorded no (never use, not even blurred), unknown (treat as no), not_needed (the co-founders).

scope.description: What the yes covers. one_existing_post_only: may stay in the one post already published; never in new content.

ai_processing.description: true only when the yes on record names AI motion (Higgsfield); null = unknown = no.

parent_yes.description: For kind child: a parent's yes is on record. Kids still never appear until the owners decide.

where.description: Where the yes is logged, e.g. Doc 04.
